name: RRSOS PCC Give Item
description: Chat command /giveitem <item> [quantity]: puts the item into the player's backpack, one at a time through the game's own add call. If the backpack has less room than asked for it takes what fits. The item can be an id or any name in this mod's own aliases.txt (in its data folder, first made as a copy of the shared one); /giveitem add <item id> <name> gives an item another name. No terminal needed.

commands.name: /giveitem
commands.help: put an item into your backpack

commands.name: /giveitem add
commands.help: give an item another name for /giveitem
